# Repository instructions

Read `CLAUDE.md`, at the root of this repository, before anything else, and
follow what it says. It is the one file this repository's rules are written
in: what is being built, which document answers what, what may not be done,
and how a change is delivered here.

Nothing of it is repeated below, on purpose. One edit to `CLAUDE.md` is what
moves every assistant that works in this repository, and a rule written
twice is a rule that disagrees with itself by the second edit.

The delivery process is `docs/05-Process.md`, and the commands that run it
are the prompt files in `.github/prompts/`.
